scripts.postbuild: copy CSInterface.js dist\ && copy .debug dist\ && if not exist dist\CSXS mkdir dist\CSXS && copy CSXS\manifest.xml dist\CSXS\ && copy CSXS\hostscript.jsx dist\CSXS\
scripts.deploy: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$target=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Adobe\\CEP\\extensions\\com.ngs.lyricmotion'; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $target; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Recurse -Force }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'dist' -Destination $target -Recurse -Force"
